Job Description:
Education and Experience Required: Enrolled in University.
Duration: 6 months.
Internship – Systems Engineer (Networking)
This internship is designed for recent graduates who want to start a career in technical presales on enterprise networking.
Who We Are
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what's next, and we value diverse backgrounds. If you are looking to start and grow your career, our culture will embrace you.
About the Internship
HPE Networking is redefining the intelligent edge: campus, branch, data center, mobility and IoT networks that combine connectivity, security and AI-driven operations. We help some of the largest organizations in Italy modernize their networks for a digital future.
As an Intern Systems Engineer you will join the Italian presales team and learn how technology turns into customer solutions. You will work side by side with experienced Systems Engineers, with a dedicated mentor and a structured training plan, gaining real exposure to customers, partners and the full sales cycle.
What You Will Do
With the guidance of your mentor, you will:
Learn the HPE Networking portfolio (wired and wireless LAN, SD-WAN, SASE, network access control, cloud and AI-driven management) through structured training and hands-on labs
Support Systems Engineers in preparing and delivering presentations and product demonstrations to customers and partners
Take part in customer meetings, workshops and proof-of-concepts, helping with lab setup, configuration and test documentation
Contribute to technical documentation: solution designs, bills of materials, answers to technical requirements in tenders
Participate in internal enablement sessions and work toward your first vendor certifications
Who We Are Looking For
Recent graduate in Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or a related field
Basic knowledge of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, OSI model, switching, VLANs, Wi-Fi
Basic understanding of network security and cloud concepts
Strong curiosity for technology and willingness to learn fast
Good communication skills and interest in customer-facing roles
Team player with a positive, proactive attitude
Good knowledge of English, spoken and written; fluent Italian
Nice to Have
Entry-level certifications (e.g. CCNA, HPE/Aruba ACA, Juniper JNCIA) or related university courses
Thesis, projects or lab experience on networking, security, cloud or automation
What We Offer
A structured internship with a dedicated mentor and a training path on the HPE Networking portfolio
Real exposure to enterprise customers, partners and projects
Access to labs, demo equipment and certification programs
Internship allowance and hybrid work model
A diverse and dynamic environment where interns are actively considered for future junior Systems Engineer positions
Join us and make your mark!

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
